description:
Closes the gap between Filament's current state and the original proposal for Items 0–4. These five items must be completed in order — each blocks the next.

ACCEPTANCE: The todo example (examples/todo/) runs at http://localhost:4001, shows todos from the observable store, supports adding/toggling/removing todos, all interactions work in Chrome without page reload, child TodoItem components render as distinct fibers with keyed reconciliation.

SCOPE (in order):
  0. Stable use_state setters (hooks.ex + live_view.ex)
  1a. VNodeCompiler: lexical @-variable scoping (new file + sigil_f.ex update)
  1b. VNodeCompiler: reactive scope inference (auto-memoization)
  2. Complete render_vnode/2 (:element HTML, :component fiber registration, :keyed_list key matching)
  3. Reconciler child walk using new_fibers from render
  4. TodoList rewrite using VNodeCompiler and child TodoItem components

OUT OF SCOPE: defcomponent auto-binding (Item 5), inventory hold demo (Item 6), memoization validation (Item 7).

REPO: /Users/j5n/Workspace/filament
BRANCH: work off main, commit each item as a logical unit.
title: Filament Gap Closure: Stable Setters, VNodeCompiler, Renderer, Reconciler, TodoList (Items 0-4)
